text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · FRI 30 OCT ₿ BTC $76,916 (-1.1%) · ETH $2,204 (-2.0%) · Fear & Greed 30 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,937 (+1.1%) · SENSEX 74,151 (+1.2%) at Thursday's close 🚨 Binance has confirmed it was hacked. From 20:24 UTC last night, coins left its hot wallets for a brand-new address: about $3.5B counted on chain (The Block), and some counts run above $5.7B. Binance says the attacker got in through a compromised engineer's laptop and submitted unauthorized withdrawals. It has paused withdrawals on several networks as a precaution, says user funds are safe, and says it will cover all losses. Tether and Circle froze about $1.8B of the moved funds, and BNB fell more than 5.5%. 📉 Bitcoin dropped to $76,330 this morning on Kraken, its lowest since 18 September, and trades near $76,900. ETH is near $2,200. Fear & Greed fell from 51 to 30 in two days. 🏦 The Fed held rates at 3.75–4.00% on Wednesday, with two of twelve voting for a hike.
